notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-2). Two short turns, then a manual compaction (POST /compact). The scenario's arc: each turn working → ready, then ready → working at the compaction's start and working → ready at its end, then ready holds. The compaction writes only a compaction row and an idle row (probe).

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — an API session is first seen working (P4; P5a's smoke cells)
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
Turn 1 drives the session to working
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded ends turn 1 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
Turn 2 drives the session to working
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded ends turn 2 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
The compaction starts: ready → working on the SAME session (in place, no new session)
The compaction completes: working → ready on the same session
After compaction the session holds ready — no further turn, never waiting
